GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat 3rd Two Wide 3 Lengths 1000m, Hard Ridden and losing ground before the corner, weakened in Straight # weakened
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 6th 5 Lengths 600m 3 Wide 8th home turn Hard Ridden last no run on Straight # back/never in it
jumped well quickly outside leader 1len 800m 2nd .5len Hard Ridden 500m Straightened Up 3rd weakened final 300m # pace/no finish
Jumped Ok took sit Mid Field 3 Wide 7len 500m 6len Wide Checked 200m no run on # average effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was held up rounding the home turn. Near the 300m was checked when tightened between runners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 7 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: When asked to comment on the performance, jockey reported it did not appreciate the track conditions.] # never a factor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1200m, steadied from heels. Rdr reported gelding did not appreciate track conditions.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly then Went Forward to 3 Wide joint Lead settling down, went clear inside 1300m and crossed at 1200m, Held Together in front middle stages, joined at 600m, Headed 450m, trailed 2 Lengths turning and Lost Ground in Straight # weak once headed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping.  Raced wide, without cover, in the early stages before working forward to lead the event near the 1200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well off the rails gate didn't look to lead settled down three back fence 3-4 Lengths (1600m), just looking for room 600, off rail before Turn Under Pressure though, Straightened Up Under Whip , only wacked away # one-paced effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly when being restrained near the 1800m for a short distance, before continuing to race keenly in the middle stages. Held up for clear running from the 400m until the 250m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began evenly. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (5L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & pushed out Four Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Seven Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Held ground Five Wide in last 200m. # Fair effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages. Approaching the 1000m shifted out off the heels of a runner when that runner lost ground.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover , Held Up 700m-400m, trailed 5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, hooked 4-5 Wide Straightening Up and kept trying in Straight # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 700m, improved onto heels and steadied. Held up for clear running from the 700m until approaching the 400m. Laid in under pressure in the early stages of the home straight. Rdr dropped whip near the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 1.5 Lengths Lead on fence, Held Together middle stages, Headed 550m and trailed 1 length turning, Lost Ground in Straight # weak once headed
